scope: Eight bounded source-document/static-code/identity review tasks and independent private development intake.
remaining_limits: Vendor login/HTTP403 pages are access outcomes rather than driver packages or proof of non-support.
Publisher installer checksums differ from locally acquired original hashes.
Source identity, model/family candidates, declared dependencies and static implementation do not prove installed firmware/options or runtime support.
Distinct source licenses and file notices are preserved; dependency/vendor-binary rights remain separately reviewed.
Simulation fallback values, caches, completion and empty abort/disable implementations do not establish physical measurement validity or output safety.
Identity conflicts and sensor-host/calibration relationships remain preserved without automatic model merges or database corrections.
